articles.title: Pfizer and BioNTech Receive Health Sciences Authority Approval for SARS-CoV-2 Sublineage LP.8.1-Adapted Monovalent COVID-19 Vaccine in Singapore
articles.content: Pfizer Singapore and BioNTech SE (Nasdaq: BNTX, BioNTech ) today announced that the Health Sciences Authority has approved the companies' LP.8.1-adapted monovalent COVID-19 vaccine (COMIRNATY® LP.8.1; COVID-19 Vaccine, mRNA) for use in individuals 6 months of age and older, according to official recommendations*. This marks Singapore as the first country in Southeast Asia to receive full approval for the latest COVID-19 vaccine.
